scope: Final targeted WebKit validation against the frozen current source. Three suites ran in parallel on separate local static servers. No source changes were made.
limits: WebKit browser automation and iPhone viewports do not establish physical iPhone microphone/storage/network behavior. Root handles final offline/assembled-site and CI integration.

results: New learners start with meanings, match the lesson words, and see models before the first supported check
Multiple independent contexts complete a lesson that credits its vocabulary and completes no verb case
An error gives feedback, a repair model, and a supported retry; Back cannot submit twice
Saved typing drafts and shuffled choices survive reload without evidence or XP duplication
Matching cards disappear only on a correct pair and errors are retained
A mismatched pair leaves that word uncredited while the others are credited
Open work is saved for self-review and is never treated as a right or wrong answer
Source readings stay available beside their questions
Listening checks cannot be credited by reading a transcript or with no played audio
Listening evidence requires completed playback of its source
The EN toggle exposes help without granting independent reading credit
A prerequisite detour preserves a return to the interrupted lesson
Skip retains unfinished skills and Pause/Resume preserves the current lesson
Placement gives a conservative suggestion without completing any lesson or awarding XP
B2 placement supports sentence ordering, reload, and a complete next-stage suggestion
An interrupted placement with no available questions returns a usable suggestion
Personal recordings are isolated by profile and removed on progress reset
A microphone response counts only after audio is saved, including navigation while it stops
Feedback and Continue stay in the viewport at compact and large iPhone sizes
